rules.text: Use a number-owned connection for the intended customer. A Slack connection for one number does not configure another number.
rules.why: The adapter checks the business number and its owning account.

rules.text: The Slack settings read cannot recover a saved incoming webhook URL.
rules.instead: Read webhook_url_set to check configuration. Enter the replacement secret on your server when rotating it.

rules.text: Connect Slack notifications, GoHighLevel or a supported automation through Zapier or Make. Use the matching integration resource for that business number.
Supply the supported endpoint and settings for the chosen adapter. Verify the number and destination before making a change.
A Slack incoming webhook must be a supported HTTPS Slack endpoint. A generic automation URL belongs to its corresponding adapter.
Inspect a connection before replacing its configuration.
invalid_url means the destination failed validation. Correct the HTTPS endpoint for the selected integration.
